note: This file is a pure Python-style configuration file for MMDetection. It contains no callable functions, classes, or methods — only variable assignments, imports, and dictionary updates that configure training pipelines, dataloaders, optimizers, and schedulers for COCO dataset object detection. No actionable tool examples can be generated.
config_purpose: MMDetection 90k iteration training schedule for COCO dataset
key_components: train_pipeline: image loading, annotation loading, multi-scale random resize, random flip, and input packing for training
test_pipeline: image loading, fixed resize, annotation loading, and input packing for evaluation
train_dataloader: InfiniteSampler with AspectRatioBatchSampler, batch_size=2, COCO train2017 dataset
val_dataloader: DefaultSampler, batch_size=1, COCO val2017 dataset
param_scheduler: LinearLR warmup (1000 iters) followed by MultiStepLR with milestones at 60k and 80k iterations
optim_wrapper: SGD optimizer with lr=0.02, momentum=0.9, weight_decay=0.0001
train_cfg: IterBasedTrainLoop for 90000 iterations with validation every 10000 iters
val_evaluator: CocoMetric for bounding box evaluation on COCO val2017
